name: Bohnanza

categories.label: Gold coins
categories.hint: After harvesting every field at game end, count the cards in your gold coin stack (1 coin each). Cards in hand do not count.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player seated furthest from the starting player (clockwise) wins

notes: family: set-collection. Game ends when the draw pile is exhausted the 3rd time (3 players with the 3-new-beans variant: 2nd time; 2-player duel: 1st time). Harvest all fields at the end, then count the coin stack. Cards still in hand score nothing.

sources.title: Bohnanza rulebook (Rio Grande Games / AMIGO v5.0)
sources.section: p.6 The End of the Game; p.7 variants
